# `openinference.llm` span

**Stability:** Development

A call to a large language model, such as a chat completion or a text completion request. It captures the request sent to the provider and the response that came back.

`openinference.span.kind` MUST be `LLM`.

A completions (non-chat) API call records `llm.prompts` and `llm.choices`
in place of `llm.input_messages` and `llm.output_messages`.

See [LLM Spans](https://github.com/Arize-ai/openinference/blob/main/spec/spans/llm.md).

**Span name** is not constrained. It SHOULD identify the operation, e.g. `ChatCompletion`.
